protocol_name: Module 3: load capsules, lysis, washes, reverse transcription, wash, release - module3_v1

events.narration: Load the capsule suspension into the trap through the pre-filter. Capsules settle on the retention gap and the carrier leaves through the wash waste; the load is one chamber volume.

Lyse the cells in the capsules: push lysis buffer through the bed to its own dedicated waste line, which never meets the other waste. SWEEP: 4.6 chamber volumes, which is what the 99% exchange goal needs in a well-mixed chamber (what is left after V chamber volumes is exp(-V)), so the bed is fully exchanged.
Lysis dwell with every port capped, at room temperature, so the lysis buffer reaches the cells inside the capsules.

Wash out the lysis buffer through the retention gap to the wash waste, since carryover would inhibit the next step. SWEEP: 4.6 chamber volumes, the 99% exchange goal for a well-mixed chamber. This used to ask for 15 chamber volumes, which no contract value implied and which needed more wash buffer than a reservoir holds.

Fill the trap with the reverse-transcription mix, which carries a plain poly(dT) primer: no barcode and no UMI are added by reverse transcription itself. The per-cell barcode comes from the NEXT stage (protocols/sctip_spc_v1.json), where each capsule is re-injected into its own oil droplet and a single barcode molecule is clonally amplified there and overlap-extended onto this cDNA, so the data is single-cell. The per-lane label from module 1 and module 4's sublibrary index are for demultiplexing, not resolution. FILL: one chamber volume, so the bed is covered and no more is spent. It is a fill and not a sweep - the wash before it already cleared the trap - so it is bounded above by the chamber, not below by the sweep rule.

Reverse transcription: one isothermal hold in the trap, in the heated zone under the chamber, with every port capped. The only thermal step on this chip; the chamber is held between 4 and 50 C by its thermal zone.
Wash the reverse-transcription mix out through the retention gap to the wash waste, leaving cDNA inside the capsules. SWEEP: 4.6 chamber volumes, the 99% exchange goal for a well-mixed chamber.

Back-flush the trap through backflush_in: liquid pushed up through the retention gap lifts the capsules off it and sweeps them towards the capsule outlet. SWEEP, and sized like one: the bed comes off as exp(-2V) in chamber volumes V, so one chamber volume lifts only 86% against the 95% back-flush target, which is what this step used to ask for. 4.6 chamber volumes at 59.4 uL/min, which is above the 30 uL/min lift flow the bed needs to leave the weir at all.
Release the capsules to module 4 as one counted suspension through to_split_tree. 2 chamber volumes of buffer carry the bed out; module 4 then splits it into the sublibraries and adds the index.
